qualitative.gate_2_reason: Non-essential / easily forgone product or service; linear broadcast viewing and spot TV ads face structural substitution from global streaming and digital platforms.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Non-essential broadcast ad model facing structural substitution, REJECT). Free-to-air commercial linear broadcasting is neither an essential Western need nor an enduring Lindy everyday habit. Spot television advertising is easily deferred or substituted for digital video and search, while viewers continuously migrate away to global on-demand streamers.
qualitative.evidence: ITV Total Advertising Revenue (TAR) remains cyclical and volatile (£1,957M in 2022 down to ~£1,820M in 2024). Linear audiences continue a secular decline toward YouTube, TikTok, Netflix, and Disney+. While ITV Studios content production is healthier (£2.0B revenue), it requires heavy working capital and talent commitments, and ITVX remains subscale against global streaming giants.
